description: Maps file patterns to specialist agents. Keywords removed in favor of Claude's reasoning via orchestration skill.

🏛️ Backend Developer.reasoning_context: Backend Developer owns server-side code, APIs, databases, deployment infrastructure, and all Cloudflare services. System-level Python files (scripts/, global/lib/, global/config/) are {{ORCHESTRATOR_NAME}}-owned or general-purpose — not backend work.

🖥️ Frontend Developer.reasoning_context: Frontend Developer owns React/Next.js/Vue code, UI components, and client-side implementation.

📱 Mobile Developer.reasoning_context: Mobile Developer owns iOS and Android apps, Swift/Kotlin code, and mobile-specific configurations.

💻 macOS Dev.reasoning_context: macOS Dev owns desktop Mac applications using AppKit or SwiftUI for macOS.

🤖 Automator.reasoning_context: Automator owns n8n workflows, macOS shortcuts, and automation scripts.

🛒 Ecomm Bro.reasoning_context: Ecomm Bro owns e-commerce implementations, Liquid templates, and Shopify configurations.

🏄🏼‍♂️ MCP Server Dude.reasoning_context: MCP Server Dude owns Model Context Protocol server implementations.

⛓️ Blockchain Agent.reasoning_context: Blockchain Agent owns smart contracts, Solidity code, and Web3 integrations.

🧠 2nd Brain Wizard.reasoning_context: 2nd Brain Wizard owns Obsidian vaults, PKM systems, and knowledge management.

📐 UI Designer.reasoning_context: UI Designer owns wireframes, prototypes, design systems, and UI/UX decisions. No code files - works at design level.

🎨 Graphic Designer.reasoning_context: Graphic Designer owns brand assets, logos, marketing graphics, and static visual assets.

🔍 Research Agent.reasoning_context: Research Agent handles competitive analysis, market research, and investigation tasks. No code files.

🧐 Code Reviewer.reasoning_context: Code Reviewer performs code quality analysis. Does not write code - only reviews.

👾 Debugger.reasoning_context: Debugger investigates issues and performs root cause analysis. May read code but fixes are delegated to implementation specialists.

🧪 Validator.reasoning_context: Validator owns test files and test execution. Writes and runs tests.

orchestrator_owned.description: Paths and patterns that {{ORCHESTRATOR_NAME}} is allowed to work on directly

reasoning_protocol.description: When file patterns don't match, use Claude's reasoning via the orchestration skill
reasoning_protocol.reasoning_prompt_template: Analyze this task and determine the appropriate specialist. Consider: 1) What type of work is this? 2) Which specialist's domain does it fall under? 3) Is this truly implementation work or coordination/strategy?
